title: Signature Causal Mesh Notation
description: Justin Addam Higgins' original notation for causal assumptions: a mesh where every arrow carries a Signature stamp recording who asserted it, when, and on what evidence. Unlike plain DAGs, the mesh never lets an assumption hide — each edge is traceable to its source.

demo.code:
import random
random.seed(1001)
n=200; beta=0.8; gamma=0.6
C=[random.gauss(0,1) for _ in range(n)]
X=[0.5*c+random.gauss(0,1) for c in C]
Y=[beta*x+gamma*c+random.gauss(0,1) for x,c in zip(X,C)]
def slope(xs,ys):
    mx=sum(xs)/len(xs); my=sum(ys)/len(ys)
    return sum((x-mx)*(y-my) for x,y in zip(xs,ys))/max(1e-9,sum((x-mx)**2 for x in xs))
naive=slope(X,Y)
bxc=slope(C,X); byc=slope(C,Y)
Xr=[x-bxc*c for x,c in zip(X,C)]; Yr=[y-byc*c for y,c in zip(Y,C)]
adj=slope(Xr,Yr)
print(f"n=200 true_beta={beta:.2f} naive={naive:.3f} adjusted={adj:.3f}")
print(f"bias_naive={abs(naive-beta):.3f} bias_adjusted={abs(adj-beta):.3f}")
print("DEMO_OK")
demo.output:
n=200 true_beta=0.80 naive=1.052 adjusted=0.818
bias_naive=0.252 bias_adjusted=0.018
DEMO_OK
demo.note: Runnable demo program verified by execution during the database build.
